title: First Look at MXP Sydney 2026: Exploring Product Intelligence in an AI-First World with Mixpanel Leaders
summary: Join MXP Sydney on November 12, 2026, for insights on product intelligence and AI with Mixpanel’s CEO and CTO.
body_markdown:
👀


First look at what’s coming to MXP Sydney


🇦🇺


We’re kicking off


MXP Sydney


with a conversation on where product intelligence is headed in an AI-first world. Joining us for the keynote:


🎤


Jen Taylor — CEO, Mixpanel


🎤


Anant Gupta — CTO, Mixpanel They’ll share Mixpanel’s AI-first vision and unpack what this means for how product teams understand users, uncover deeper insights and turn product data into better decisions. They’ll explore how AI can help teams move beyond simply understanding what users are doing to uncovering why it’s happening, identifying opportunities faster and making more informed decisions about what to build next.


📅


12 November 2026


📍


Sydney More speakers and sessions coming your way soon. If you’re in Sydney, we’d love to see you there.


👉
